To toss the salad, start by separating the ingredients into two even piles. Then take one pile and gently toss it with the other pile, keeping the ingredients evenly mixed. Continue tossing until all the ingredients are evenly distributed.

If you are concerned about a runaway girl, you should immediately contact your local law enforcement. They will be able to help you with finding the girl and taking the necessary steps to ensure her safety. You can also contact the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC) at 1-800-THE-LOST. They will provide assistance in locating the girl and helping her return home safely. Additionally, you should also check with local shelters and missions to see if the girl has been reported there.
